밥.t: 밥 means any meal: 밥 먹었어요? (Did you eat?) is a common greeting. For elders: 진지 드셨어요?

비빔밥.e: 비빔 (mixing, from 비비다 to mix) + 밥 (rice) — 'mixed rice'.
비빔밥.t: Pronounced [비빔빱]: 밥 becomes tense in this compound.

막히다.m: to be blocked, to be clogged; to be jammed (traffic)
막히다.x: Traffic is really bad at rush hour.
막히다.t: Pronounced [마키다]: ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

입술.ex: 겨울에는 입술이 자주 말라서 립밤을 발라요.
입술.x: In winter my lips often get dry, so I put on lip balm.
입술.t: Pronounced [입쑬]: the ㅅ becomes tense after ㅂ.

상사.x: I asked my boss for time off next week.
상사.t: A homonym 상사 (different hanja) means 'trading company', as in 종합 상사.

성과.x: I worked hard and got good results.

독신.m: single life, being unmarried; single person
독신.ex: 그는 결혼하지 않고 평생 독신으로 살았어요.
독신.x: He never married and lived single all his life.
독신.t: 독신 suggests a long-term or lifelong single life; 미혼 just means 'not married yet'.

박자.ex: 노래할 때 박자를 잘 맞추는 것이 중요해요.
박자.x: When singing, it's important to keep the beat well.
박자.e: Literally 'clap'; 박수 'applause' shares the same 박.
박자.t: Pronounced [박짜]; collocations: 박자를 맞추다 (keep time), 박자를 놓치다 (miss the beat).

경솔하다.x: I'm sorry for speaking so thoughtlessly.
경솔하다.e: Literally 'light and hasty' — not weighing your words.
경솔하다.t: Common in apologies: 제가 경솔했습니다 'I was thoughtless.'

비롯하다.forms: N을/를 비롯해(서) · N을/를 비롯한 (+noun) · N에서 비롯되다
비롯하다.m: to begin with, including (and others), starting with
비롯하다.x: Large cities, including Seoul, have large populations.
비롯하다.e: Related to 비롯 'beginning'; 비롯되다 means 'to originate from'.
비롯하다.t: Pronounced [비로타다]; N을 비롯한 lists the main example first, like 'X and others'.

축소하다.m: to reduce, to scale down, to shrink
축소하다.x: The economy was bad, so the company downsized.

빼앗다.x: My younger sibling snatched my snack and ate it.
빼앗다.t: In speech it is often shortened to 뺏다: 뺏어요, 뺏었어요.

목이 빠지게 기다리다.forms: 목이 빠지게 기다려요 · 목이 빠지게 기다렸어요
목이 빠지게 기다리다.m: to wait anxiously, to wait with bated breath
목이 빠지게 기다리다.ex: 할머니는 손자가 오기를 목이 빠지게 기다리셨어요.
목이 빠지게 기다리다.x: Grandma waited eagerly for her grandson to arrive.
목이 빠지게 기다리다.e: Literally 'to wait until your neck comes loose' from craning it to look.

무릎을 꿇다.m: to kneel; to give in, to surrender, to lose
무릎을 꿇다.ex: 우리 팀은 결승전에서 강한 상대에게 무릎을 꿇었어요.
무릎을 꿇다.x: Our team fell to a strong opponent in the final.
무릎을 꿇다.e: Literally 'to bend the knees'; kneeling shows apology or defeat.
무릎을 꿇다.t: Pronounced [꿀타]: the ㅎ of ㅀ combines with ㄷ into aspirated ㅌ.

상견례.m: formal meeting between the families of an engaged couple
상견례.x: Next month our families are meeting formally.
상견례.t: Pronounced [상견녜] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㄴ.

냉전.ex: 냉전이 끝난 뒤 세계 질서가 크게 바뀌었습니다.
냉전.x: After the Cold War ended, the world order changed greatly.
냉전.e: A direct translation of English 'cold war'.
냉전.t: Also used figuratively for a silent standoff: 부부가 냉전 중이에요 'The couple aren't speaking.'

공조.ex: 두 나라는 테러 대응을 위해 긴밀한 공조를 약속했습니다.
공조.x: The two countries pledged close cooperation in responding to terrorism.

봉쇄.ex: 해군이 항구를 봉쇄해서 배가 들어올 수 없었습니다.
봉쇄.x: The navy blockaded the port, so ships couldn't enter.

중지하다.m: to stop, to suspend, to halt
중지하다.x: They stopped the game because of heavy rain.
중지하다.t: 중지 halts something already underway; 금지 forbids it from happening at all.

용인하다.m: to tolerate, to accept, to allow
용인하다.ex: 사회는 어떤 형태의 폭력도 용인해서는 안 됩니다.
용인하다.x: Society must not tolerate any form of violence.

보수적.ex: 할아버지는 결혼에 대해 아주 보수적인 생각을 갖고 계세요.
보수적.x: My grandfather has very conservative views about marriage.
보수적.e: Literally 'protecting and guarding' what already exists.
보수적.t: Homonym alert: 보수 also means 'pay, compensation' and 'repair' — different hanja.

거짓되다.ex: 그 광고는 거짓된 정보로 소비자를 속였습니다.
거짓되다.x: That ad deceived consumers with false information.
거짓되다.e: 거짓 'a lie' + -되다, a suffix that makes describing words.

근본적으로.ex: 이 문제를 근본적으로 해결할 방법이 필요합니다.
근본적으로.x: We need a way to solve this problem at its root.

다다익선.ex: 봉사자는 다다익선이니까 시간 되는 분은 모두 와 주세요.
다다익선.x: When it comes to volunteers, the more the better, so anyone with time, please come.
rel: too much is as bad as too little

중도금.m: interim payment, middle installment (in a real estate or large purchase deal)
중도금.ex: 다음 달 말까지 아파트 중도금을 내야 해요.
중도금.x: I have to make the interim payment on the apartment by the end of next month.
중도금.e: Literally 'money paid midway' — between the down payment and the final balance.
중도금.t: Korean home purchases usually go 계약금 → 중도금 → 잔금, in that order.

강자.ex: 이 팀은 아시아 축구의 강자로 알려져 있어요.
강자.x: This team is known as a powerhouse in Asian soccer.

겹치다.m: to overlap; to coincide, clash (schedules); to pile up
겹치다.ex: 두 수업 시간이 겹쳐서 하나만 들을 수 있어요.
겹치다.x: The two class times overlap, so I can only take one.
겹치다.e: From 겹 (layer, fold): things lying layer on layer.
겹치다.t: Also used for bad luck piling up: 불행이 겹치다 (misfortunes come one after another).

상기하다.m: to recall, to call to mind, to bring back to mind
상기하다.ex: 회의를 시작하기 전에 지난번 결정 사항을 다시 상기해 봅시다.
상기하다.x: Before we start the meeting, let's recall the decisions we made last time.
상기하다.t: 상기시키다 means 'to remind someone': 중요성을 상기시키다 = to remind people of the importance.
rel: to go over in one's mind

양머리.x: At the jjimjilbang I made a sheep-head hat out of a towel and wore it.
양머리.t: A towel rolled into a hat with two 'ears' at the sides. It became famous through Korean dramas set in jjimjilbang.

잔뼈가 굵다.m: to be a seasoned veteran, to have grown up in a field (lit. one's small bones have grown thick)
잔뼈가 굵다.ex: 그분은 이 업계에서 잔뼈가 굵은 분이에요.
잔뼈가 굵다.x: He's a seasoned veteran in this industry.
잔뼈가 굵다.e: 잔뼈 are the small bones of a child; they 'grow thick' as one grows up, so the phrase means one has grown up and matured in that line of work.
잔뼈가 굵다.t: Pronounced [잔뼈가 국따]. Usually ~에서 잔뼈가 굵은 + person; a compliment about long hands-on experience.

유언장.x: Grandfather left a will before he passed away.
유언장.e: Literally 'a document of words left behind'.

용매.x: Water is the most commonly used solvent.
용매.t: 용매 + 용질 = 용액: solvent + solute = solution.

마찰력.ex: 얼음 위에서는 마찰력이 작아서 미끄러지기 쉬워요.
마찰력.x: On ice there's little friction, so it's easy to slip.
마찰력.e: Literally 'rubbing force'. -력 = force, power: 마찰력, 중력, 노력.
마찰력.t: 마찰 alone also means conflict between people or countries, as in 무역 마찰 'trade friction'.

평전.x: I bought a critical biography of a poet at the bookstore.
평전.e: Literally 'critiqued biography' — tells a life while evaluating it.

발본색원.m: rooting out completely, eradicating at the source
발본색원.ex: 정부는 공직 사회의 부정부패를 반드시 발본색원하겠다고 발표했습니다.
발본색원.x: The government announced it would completely root out corruption in public service.
발본색원.e: Literally 'pull up the root, block the source'.
발본색원.t: A favorite in news and politics: 비리를 발본색원하다 'to root out corruption'.

허위정보.x: False information spread rapidly during the election period.

역임하다.m: to have served (successively) as, to have held (a post)
역임하다.x: He served as foreign minister and prime minister.
역임하다.e: Literally 'pass through offices': listing posts held in a career.

양태.x: As society changed, the forms of family became more diverse.

모순성.x: His argument shows a lot of contradictions.
모순성.e: From an old tale of a seller praising an unstoppable spear and an unbreakable shield.
